Also, it is very difficult to identify the stage of a disease as patient comes from different backgrounds e.g., patient visiting ayurvedic physician with some disease while consuming modern medicines. Generally, it is observed that while managing the bio chemical parameters for that specific disease, there is considerable loss of quality of life of a patient. There is a need for better clinically tested alternatives from Ayurved. Here Ayurveda's fundamentals come in picture, that it treats the patient along with maintaining or improving quality of life of a patient.

texts.orig: Since there is ever-growing complexity in causative factors, there is development of new diseases, with complex criss cross pathologies, it is difficult to diagnose the patient under one specific disease. Also, there are new group of symptoms and diagnostic methods coming in picture. Because of this, it becomes very difficult for an Ayurved practitioner to give enough time, efforts, limited mental bandwidth to study Ayurved first and then analyse newly coming diseases and diagnostic methods, which are not discussed under clear heads in classical texts of Ayurved. Most of such diseases are considered under Gudhalinga Vyadhi. Additionally, with increased challenges of today's era, it is becoming difficult for every Vaidya to understand the text at base level, with the help of grammar, Teekas, Nyayas etc. Hence it is very challenging to identify the exact stage of a vyadhi, along with its Sadhyasadhyatva, dosha dhatu Bala, satva etc. This leads to higher risk of misdiagnosis of the condition of a patient or wrong judgement about the chikitsa Tatva and chikitsa dravya and so on.

texts.orig: Considering DM, India has become the global capital with increasing number of diagnosed and undiagnosed or lately diagnosed patients. Currently management of blood sugar level is considered as the only method of treatment. But as all of us know that management of BSL only is not enough treatment for DM. Even patients with controlled BSL develop further DM complications over the period. Ayurved has its own terminology and way of explaining diseases. Many of the times DM is closely correlated with Prameha in Ayurveda. Many of the times Vaidya's get confused about the Purvaroopa, Rupa, Upadrava or even with Vyadhisankara when it comes to patients visiting ayurvedic physicians with known diagnosis of DM. Hence it is very difficult to understand the Samprapti of Meha resembling disease or DM with involvement of different Srotasa or Avayava. For the same reason it becomes challenging to understand the illness and its complications. Hence there is gap between understanding of diabetes patient and may be its possible relation with Prameha.

texts.orig: Anticipating this need and to make Ayurveda practice easy, yet reproducible result-oriented solutions for upcoming generations of Vaidyas, Rasayu develops few guideline protocols for newly developing pathologies of Vyadhi. These guideline protocols are developed based on 25+ years of Ayurved practice in India and abroad, with the help of clinical data of patients and clinically proven medicines. All the medicines mentioned here have been used by patients for years together and shown safety and efficacy on Ayurveda as well as global parameters in clinical settings. texts.orig: The guidelines given in this book can be used by physicians as a quick reference for patients visiting ayurvedic clinic with known diagnosis of DM. The protocols are given anticipating the known possible or probable complications of DM patients. The main goal of these experience-based protocol sharing is how to delay/prevent/ manage successfully diabetes patients based on principles of Ayurved which is far beyond merely BSL management. Another important aspect of these guidelines is that these not only helps getting immediate gratification to the patients (Rugnasamvedya) but also for Vaidya's (Vaidyasamvedya) on Ayurveda parameters as well as globally known parameters also. This overall increases the confidence of all stake holders and finally establishes Ayurveda as a time-tested science which can withstand any global scrutiny!
